name: Listening party
summary: A first listen together, drawn as a spinning vinyl with each track as a band of grooves and the needle on the one that's playing; everyone sticks fire, fine or skip on each track and the stickers spin with the record, and after the last track it shows the group's ranked tracklist and the one track everyone called fire.
